provenance.description: Reviewed design-v3 synthetic reference geometry; explicit scale variants are designed examples, not independent factory samples.

selection.rationale: H40/t2 is a prespecified research reference informed by the historical pilot, not a demonstrated optimum; weights unchanged. No heldout outcome used.

guardrails.exposure: report completed meaningful charge sessions and WIP trend per held-out arm; withhold a self-sustaining claim if unexposed

analysis.selection_rule: No automatic recommendation. Main study needs independent layout/seed evidence; require primary practical improvement with no guardrail regression and report censored/failed arms. Pilot never declares a winner.

load.method: UNCALIBRATED design mu 0.2 tasks/s; rho is provisional, not measured bottleneck capacity. Stochastic lambda follows the generator; finite-batch lambda is releases/duration.
